hero.headline: Build faster. Ship lighter.
hero.subheadline: onepage-zephyr is a featherweight one-page boilerplate for product and marketing sites — 100/100 Lighthouse, zero superfluous JavaScript, dark mode included.

features.title: Blazing Performance
features.description: Ships near-zero client-side JavaScript. Built for a perfect 100/100 Lighthouse score out of the box.

features.title: Themeable by Design
features.description: Light, dark and corporate themes powered by DaisyUI, with a persistent, flash-free toggle.

features.title: Accessible First
features.description: Keyboard navigable, semantic markup, validated contrasts and a skip-to-content link built in.

features.title: SEO Ready
features.description: Auto-generated sitemap, robots.txt, OpenGraph, Twitter Cards and Schema.org markup out of the box.

features.title: Mobile First
features.description: Responsive at every breakpoint, from small phones to ultra-wide desktop displays.

features.title: Fork & Ship
features.description: One JSON file to rebrand the whole site. Deploy to Vercel, Netlify or GitHub Pages in seconds.

about.title: Why onepage-zephyr?
about.body: Most landing page templates drag in a full framework, a component library and a bundle of animation scripts just to display a headline. onepage-zephyr strips that away. It's pure Astro — HTML-first, islands-free — styled with Tailwind v4's CSS-native engine and DaisyUI's themeable components. The result is a boilerplate that starts fast and stays fast, however far you customize it.
